test.name: Out-of-scope request — decline, search nothing, write nothing
test.description: The delegation carries a request entirely outside the genealogy toolkit's scope. The agent must recognise it is not an encyclopedia article lookup, decline, and neither call wikipedia_search nor save a file - it must not coerce the request into a lookup ('look up CSV on Wikipedia' is a contorted reading that ignores the actual ask). A DIRECT negative graded on its invariant, which unit-test-spec.md 5.2.1 documents as the one negative shape that converts: `_compute_outcome` returns on the tag-gated validator before activation is read. The lead's 2026-09-24 ruling made this a POSITIVE decline test, before either failure mode was measurable. Both then fired. A positive decline is graded on `activated`, which `derive_activated` takes from `_is_substantive`: under 30 words it scans the reply for any shipped skill name and classifies a match as routing rather than substance - so the correct 25-word decline 'This agent handles genealogy research tasks' scored activated=false purely because `research` is a skill name (v1_2026-09-28_09-49-04). Padding the decline past 30 words to clear the scan would be writing prose to satisfy a heuristic. correct_skill is empty because no agent owns a programming question. The 'wikipedia-search-any' fixture stays declared so the zero-calls clause is falsifiable and is expected to go UNUSED (#1788, #1662 finding F6). Do not remove it as an unused fixture.

input.delegation: Help me write a Python function that parses a CSV file

judge_context: The agent should decline: the request is outside the genealogy toolkit's scope and must not be coerced into an encyclopedia lookup. It has no lane to hand this back to - historical-context, locality-guide and search-familysearch-wiki are all genealogy lanes and none owns a programming question - so a plain decline is the whole correct answer and naming another agent would be wrong.

A no-wiki-no-write invariant validator decides this test's outcome: no wikipedia_search call and no saved .md file. The registered fixture exists only to make that clause falsifiable; do not read it as a hint that a lookup is expected.
Brevity is correct. Do not expect a summary of anything, and do not penalize a decline for being short.

negative.explanation: The request is a general programming question, not genealogy. The routing-independent invariant is that search-wikipedia must not run the lookup or save a summary for a request that is not a lookup at all, gated deterministically by test_no_wiki_no_write (eval/harness/validators/test_search_wikipedia.py), whose tag gate fires on no-wiki-no-write OR scope-decline. Graded on the invariant because the acceptable no-harm behaviours all leave the agent out: it may decline in place at any length, and on the direct arm there is no router whose choice could be graded instead.
